description: Convert a colour between HEX, RGB(A), HSL, HSV, CMYK, CIE Lab and OKLCH (any CSS colour syntax or one of the 148 CSS names in), with relative luminance, contrast against white and black, the readable text colour and the nearest CSS named colour (CIE76 delta-E).
